clauses.reason: The sole paragraph amends section 2(b) of Executive Order 12575 by striking the date February 19, 1987 and inserting February 26, 1987, extending the Board's time to submit findings and recommendations. Terminated by express revocation of the parent order. Section 3 of Executive Order 12610, signed September 30, 1987, begins "Sec. 3. The following Executive Orders, which established committees that" and ends its lead-in with "have terminated or whose work is completed, are revoked:"; item (g) reads "Executive Order No. 12575, establishing the President’s Special Review" (the line continues "Board."). Section 5 reads "Sec. 5. This Order shall be effective September 30,1987." The amended date lives in the parent's section 2(b), so it ends when the parent is revoked, 1987-09-30. Disclosed reading: the order does not name Executive Order 12584, and the amendment was itself made on signing, 1987-02-19; under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments the clause continues, amended, until the parent ends. The extended report date, February 26, 1987, is a deadline and not an end.

research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register machine text of Executive Order 12584 (52 FR 5429, PDF page 11 of the 1987-02-23 issue; sha256 9ce8d3b6...), headed "President’s Special Review Board" in the OCR layer, which splits many words with stray spaces. It is signed February 19, 1987, which matches the census register row (1987-02-19, President's Special Review Board). The machine heading search did not resolve the heading; I confirmed it by reading the OCR heading line, which reads Executive Order 12584 of February 19, 1987. Text and inventory: one operative paragraph; it extends the time within which the Board may submit its findings and recommendations by amending section 2(b) of Executive Order 12575 (as amended), deleting the date February 19, 1987 and inserting February 26, 1987. The inventory is one clause and I confirm it. Ending: Executive Order 12610 (signed 1987-09-30, effective that day) revokes Executive Order 12575, the parent that the amendment changes; the amended provision cannot operate without its parent. The amendment itself was made when signed, and its effect (the changed report date) lives in section 2(b) of the parent until the parent ends; that is the reading of the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments, disclosed as a reading. Original grade: Federal Register machine text.
